verification.detail: every probability vector is on the simplex, every probability in [0, 1], every rate >= 0, every quantile function non-decreasing
verification.reference: proper conjugate posteriors: Props 'Block-rate posterior', 'Spike-and-slab Bernoulli', 'Sparse Dirichlet, exact inclusion', 'Posterior mean of a segment marginal'

verification.detail: symmetric, unit diagonal, positive semi-definite; smallest eigenvalue 5.28e-03
verification.reference: Sklar's theorem; Props 'Marginal preservation', 'The sampler targets the copula posterior'

verification.detail: mean-matrix spectral radius 0.578 (subcritical); the forest is generated conditioned on its 3 level x segment counts, so its size and depth are those of the source (scaled) whatever the radius
verification.reference: Props 'Generation sizes, finiteness and expected size', 'Hierarchy of a given size', 'Hierarchies generated level by level'

verification.detail: last 15 of 30 final sweeps (after the merge and a burn-in of half the final sweeps; the partition is the last one): split R-hat of the attribute log-likelihood 0.936, Geweke z n/a (stationary: R-hat <= 1.1, abs(z) < 3)
verification.reference: blocked Gibbs sampler (layer 1 algorithms paper, Algorithm 3); Geweke (1992); Gelman et al. (2013)

verification.detail: 20 of 20 chains pass: every correlation has split R-hat <= 1.1 or a Monte Carlo standard error <= 0.01 on the Fisher-z scale (largest R-hat 1.096, largest standard error 0.1684)
verification.reference: Prop. 'Rank likelihood with parameter expansion'; split R-hat (Gelman et al. 2013); fixed-width stopping (Jones et al. 2006; Flegal, Haran & Jones 2008)
